body_markdown:
[Ilia](https://forum.virtualmin.com/u/Ilia)


November 5, 2026, 12:49pm 1


Howdy,


After a good deal of work and testing, I’m happy to announce a new Virtualmin GoAccess module.


It is a modern replacement for the AWStats and Webalizer reports, with an interactive, good-looking dashboard that follows your Virtualmin theme in both light and dark modes.


What it does:


- Builds a GoAccess report from each website’s access logs, including rotated and gzip-compressed ones
- Updates hourly, daily or on demand, with a one-click Update Report button
- Shows visitors, requested files, referrers, browsers, status codes and more
- Lets domain owners view and update their own reports
- Includes report settings and the last report in Virtualmin backups


To get started, install the plugin from the repository by package name` webmin-virtualmin-goaccess` , enable GoAccess reporting under “System Settings → Features and Plugins”, and then turn it on for a virtual server. The report appears under “Logs and Reports → GoAccess Report”.


All new Virtualmin installations will ship with GoAccess as the default statistics tool in place.


[hero-light 1920×1107 377 KB](https://cdn.forum.virtualmin.com/uploads/default/original/3X/0/0/00b11fc27cd50bd36eeecdfb8d3c43a634482f4b.jpeg)


[hero-dark 1920×1106 319 KB](https://cdn.forum.virtualmin.com/uploads/default/original/3X/7/d/7dbc5a9ae959b277e66f85231af5bf117635d9fd.jpeg)


Requirements are Webmin 2.670 or later, Virtualmin 8.2 or later and GoAccess 1.7 or later.


Feedback and bug reports are welcome!
